calibration_semantics: Eight purposively selected local examples; no global accuracy estimate and no automatic semantic promotion.

rules.allowed: regional continuity evidence, locally supported massif flank
rules.forbidden_promotion: elevation threshold as exact mountain boundary
rules.warning: Regional identity can be supported while its sampled boundary remains provisional.
Unverified V1 passes remain hypotheses; no direct NFEAT promotion. The 614 point is a microdepression; nearby 621 corridor is local evidence.
No consolidated major valley is created from V1 valley labels alone; floor width is not applicable without opposed walls.

rules.allowed: low-relief regional context with actual member/edge distinction
rules.forbidden_promotion: representative point as center of fully flat terrain
rules.warning: V1 point is at the bank; accepted low-slope seed is 16 blocks away; sampled area is censored.

rules.forbidden_promotion: entire closed plateau inferred from local mask
rules.warning: Local tableland is supported; full regional extent remains open.

rules.forbidden_promotion: closed independent lake from coarse water component
rules.warning: Use actual surface-water intervals for connectivity; keep flow_direction=unknown and closure unknown outside observed ROI.

rules.allowed: island only where real outer water ring is verified
rules.forbidden_promotion: all coarse land components as confirmed islands
rules.warning: Outer boundary excludes internal ponds. Only this verified island receives supported island semantics.

rules.forbidden_promotion: natural harbor, unique entrance or navigability
rules.warning: Bay feature has an observation point, not a fabricated bay polygon; source water-component footprint is broader than the bay.

global_warnings: All IDs are PROPOSED; Atlas is not World Canon or build authorization.
Biomes are environmental context, not a water connectivity or culture classifier.
flow_direction=unknown; watershed, upstream/downstream, discharge and source are not inferred.
Current surface is not a reconstruction of pristine terrain; NG-2 anthropogenic_contamination=possible.
Freshness status is checked_at evidence, not a live-world guarantee.
